text.tspan: Stack onward-dev-orders, created from templates/orders.yaml by CloudFormation Git sync
Auto Scaling group onward-dev-orders: 2 to 6 x t3.micro, target 50% average CPU, ELB health checks
HTTPS 443 through the internet gateway: dnf security updates, git clone app at AppVersion
sessions and CPU-spike demo over the
agent's outbound link, no inbound port
allowed inbound traffic and the security group rule that allows it
outbound only: updates, the app download and AWS APIs, through the Regional NAT Gateway
Faded servers are added by Auto Scaling on sales days and removed afterwards (2 to 6 in total).
No port 22 rule and no key pairs exist. Servers have no public IPs. Private subnets have no inbound route from the internet.
